entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: One of the five elder dragons of Tarkir, a cruel, venomous snake-headed dragonlord of the Sultai.

entities.name: Silumgar's brood
entities.description: Dragons and followers of Silumgar, with the most undead of any clan.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: Sultai khan who in the current timeline betrayed the other khans and became Silumgar's pet.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: Clan that revered or served Silumgar.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Group offended by Tasigur that abandoned the Sultai.

entities.name: Nagas
entities.description: Group that abandoned the Sultai; translators in Silumgar's clan.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Rival dragonlord Silumgar feared losing to.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit dragon whose dragon tempests produced the elder dragons.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Former planeswalker who used the Stormnexus Ritual to end the dragonlords' rule.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual that raised five spirit dragons and defeated the dragonlords.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which many of Silumgar's dragons were compleated.

events.summary: In the original timeline Silumgar dies in the river Marang, killed by a young Sultai khan.
events.quote: Silumgar never reached elder status and died in the river Marang

events.summary: After Tasigur offends the Rakshasa and Nagas, the Sultai make a pact with Silumgar.
events.quote: forcing them thus to make a pact with Silumgar and his brood

events.summary: Tasigur betrays the other khans and is made Silumgar's pet, displayed as a pendant.
events.quote: Silumgar still wore Tasigur's body as a pendant

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion many of Silumgar's dragons are compleated, weakening the dragonlords.
events.quote: many of Silumgar's dragons were compleated

events.summary: Narset is convinced to use the Stormnexus Ritual, raising a dragonstorm and five spirit dragons.
The dragonlords, Silumgar included, are defeated by the spirit dragons and swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm

relations.quote: to become a pet for Silumgar to display his dominance over
Silumgar's underlings emulated their dragonlord in all that they did.
losing everything he had gained to Kolaghan
